title: kit.sdk-config.v1
description: kit.sdk.json at a repository root: the SDKs `kit sdk generate` writes with @saasreport/forge (the kit's native Forge) from the repository's OpenAPI 3.1 contracts, and what `kit check sdk` enforces (docs/SDK.md). Every OpenAPI contract the repository declares (kit.canon.json contracts of type openapi, and `contracts`) has exactly one target. Paths are relative to the repository root.

$schema.description: The $id of this schema (or a path to it).

generator.description: @saasreport/forge, the kit's native Forge (ported from Cloudflare Forge, Apache-2.0): the one and compulsory SDK generator.

project.description: The project key in the kit's registry, for a repository without kit.canon.json (kit.canon.json project wins).

targets.description: One generated SDK per OpenAPI contract.

name.description: The SDK's name: the project's own prefix (registry key, prefix or short prefix), optionally followed by -<part>. The package is <name>-sdk.

out.description: Directory of the generated SDK: a subdirectory of sdk/ (no . or .. segments), not overlapping the contract or another target. Replaced on every generate, and only when it holds nothing but the files its forge.manifest.json lists.

cli.description: The CLI's command name (default: name); the project's own prefix.

languages.description: The native targets to generate (default: all). javascript: index.mjs, index.d.ts, cli.mjs, package.json; python: python/<name>_sdk/__init__.py (typed client, Python 3.11+, standard library only), py.typed, python/pyproject.toml.

contracts.description: More OpenAPI documents (files or globs) that must each have a target, beyond kit.canon.json's openapi contracts.

scan.description: Code scanned for hand-written clients (fetch() on a contract path, copies of generated files). Default: kit.canon.json hardcoding.paths, else src.

exclude.description: Globs left out of the scan (tests are always out of it by default).

allow.description: Reviewed hand-written clients, one instance each (a file and the contract path it calls), with the reviewer's reason. An entry that matches nothing is stale and fails; there is no wildcard and no expiry.

path.description: The contract path it calls, template form (/api/forms/{}).
